#Observing variables in the dataset
```{r}
# "Saving" filtered_data dataset and loading the dataset + packages
install.packages("pacman", repos = 'http://cran.us.r-project.org')

p_load(
  "tidyverse",
  "here",
  "haven",
  "janitor"
)
source(here('scripts', '0.cabbs_paths.R'))
load(file.path(path_to_analytic_data, "filtered_data.RData"))

names(filtered_data)
```


#Cross tab of all the education variables in CABBS - exploratory analysis
```{r}
table(filtered_data$YearsEducationUS, filtered_data$YearsEducationUS_Converted, exclude = F)
table(filtered_data$YearsEducationUS, filtered_data$Edu_2levels, exclude = F)
table(filtered_data$YearsEducationUS_Converted, filtered_data$Edu_2levels, exclude = F)
```


#Cross tab of Race and Education level
```{r, include = FALSE}
#Cross tabbing race/ethnicity by education level and including the NA values
race_edu_table <- table(filtered_data$RaceEthnicity_new, filtered_data$Edu_2levels, useNA = "ifany")
race_edu_row_percent <- prop.table(race_edu_table, margin = 1)

#Adding row percentages to each frequency value
n_percent_table <- matrix(
  paste0(
    race_edu_table, " (", round(100 * race_edu_row_percent, 1), "%)"
  ),
  nrow = nrow(race_edu_table),
  dimnames = dimnames(race_edu_table)
)

#Complete table with NAs
print(n_percent_table)
```



#Cross tab of final Race/Ethnicity variable and Education level - checking how many non-latino white participants had above 12 years of education
```{r, include = FALSE}
#Cross tabbing race/ethnicity by education level and including the NA values
race_edu_table_final <- table(filtered_data$RaceEthnicity_final, filtered_data$Edu_2levels, useNA = "ifany")
race_edu_row_percent1 <- prop.table(race_edu_table_final, margin = 1)

#Adding row percentages to each frequency value
n_percent_table1 <- matrix(
  paste0(
    race_edu_table_final, " (", round(100 * race_edu_row_percent1, 1), "%)"
  ),
  nrow = nrow(race_edu_table_final),
  dimnames = dimnames(race_edu_table_final)
)

#Complete table with NAs
print(n_percent_table1)
```


#Creating a clean binary numerical variable for blood draw status
```{r}
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(BD_Status_collected_clean = case_when(
    BD_Status == "Collected" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0     # everything else, including NA, becomes 0
  ))
table(filtered_data$BD_Status_collected_clean, exclude = F)

#0 = CAL-BHR participants with no complete blood draw
#1 = CABBS participants with a blood draw
```



#Recoding to set missing values to NA
```{r, include = FALSE}
#Using this variable for columns 1 and 2 in Table 1
#Creating a dichotomous variable for Blood draw status
#filtered_data$BD_Status_collected_clean <- filtered_data$BD_Status_collected  
#filtered_data$BD_Status_collected_clean[filtered_data$BD_Status_collected_clean %in% c(NA)] <- 0

#----**Recoding the NA's ---- 
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(
      "Edu_2levels",
      "Occupational_role_categories",
      "Current_employment_status_cat",
      "Marital_status_category",
      "ADI_SuppressionCode",
      "WHODAS_Cognition_D1_1",
      "WHODAS_Cognition_D1_4",
      "WHODAS_Mobility_D2_1",
      "WHODAS_Mobility_D2_5",
      "WHODAS_SelfCare_D3_1",
      "WHODAS_SelfCare_D3_2",
      "WHODAS_GettingAlong_D4_1",
      "WHODAS_GettingAlong_D4_2",
      "WHODAS_LifestyleAct_D5_1",
      "WHODAS_LifestyleAct_D5_5",
      "WHODAS_Participation_D6_1",
      "WHODAS_Participation_D6_5",
      "WHODAS_unknown_2",
      "WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H1",
      "WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H2",
      "WHODAS_EffectsOfDiffi_H3",
      "Self_reported_health_baseline",
      "Overall_health_30days",
      "APOE"
    ),
    ~ na_if(trimws(.), "") 
  ))
```




#Looking at the distribution of self-ECog score by blood draw status in CABBS
```{r, eval = FALSE}
#Only including rows where BD_Status_collected_clean is 0 or 1
plot1 <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(BD_Status_collected_clean %in% c(0, 1))

#Density plot
ggplot(plot1, aes(x = Self_ECog_score, fill = factor(BD_Status_collected_clean))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of Self-ECog Scores by Blood Draw Status",
    x = "Self-ECog Score",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Blood Draw Status"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#1f77b4", "1" = "#ff7f0e"),
                    labels = c("0" = "BD Status: 0", "1" = "BD Status: 1")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```




#Looking at baseline age distribution by blood draw status in CABBS
```{r, eval = FALSE}
#Only including rows where BD_Status_collected_clean is 0 or 1
plot2 <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(BD_Status_collected_clean %in% c(0, 1))

#density plot
ggplot(plot2, aes(x = Age_Baseline, fill = factor(BD_Status_collected_clean))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of Age by Blood Draw Status",
    x = "Age at baseline",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Blood Draw Status"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#1f77b4", "1" = "#ff7f0e"),
                    labels = c("0" = "BD Status: 0", "1" = "BD Status: 1")) +
theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```




#Looking at baseline age distribution for each race/ethnicity
```{r, eval = FALSE}
ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Age_Baseline, fill = factor(RaceEthnicity_final))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of Age by Race/Ethnicity",
    x = "Age at Baseline",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Race/Ethnicity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```


#Looking at baseline age summary statistics by each race/ethnicity
```{r, eval = FALSE}
#Summary statistics of age by RaceEthnicity_final
age_summary_table <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(RaceEthnicity_final) %>%
  summarize(
    Count = n(),
    Min_Age = min(Age_Baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Age = max(Age_Baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Age = mean(Age_Baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Age = median(Age_Baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Age = sd(Age_Baseline, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%

print(age_summary_table)

```



#Looking at age distribution for each race/ethnicity individually
```{r, eval = FALSE}
#Only looking where Race/Ethnicity is "Latino"
plot3 <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(RaceEthnicity_final == 7)

ggplot(plot3, aes(x = Age_Baseline)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Density Plot of Age for Non-Latino Other Participants",
    x = "Age at Baseline",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```



#Data exploration of Travalab appointment status



#Frequency of each variable from Travalab dataset regarding blood draw appointment status
